descriptionFull: The Colima warbler ( Leiothlypis crissalis ) is a New World warbler. It is mainly found in the Sierra Madre Occidental and Oriental of central Mexico, though its range just barely extends into adjacent southwestern Texas in the Chisos Mountains of Big Bend National Park.
